title: Chapter 155 Breakthrough
content:
Chapter 155 Breakthrough

With a creaking sound, the heavy gate of the Yan Kingdom was slowly pushed open. It had been closed for a long time on weekdays. For fear that the enemy troops from outside the city would come in, it was tightly pressed out of the city gate. In the incredible eyes of the imperial army, it pushed open open.

As the city gate opened, groups of knights in fine armor and horses on their hips rushed out. He rushed towards the imperial army outside the city.

Caught off guard by this turn of events, the imperial army never thought that the defenses in the city, who could not shrink back, would often have the guts to fight in the direction of their own barracks.

"Enemy attack, enemy attack, all battalions get ready!"

As Tanqi sent the information, the generals who stayed in the center quickly ordered their soldiers to gather and prepare to meet the enemy.

The cavalry of Yan State was getting faster and faster. A total of nearly 30,000 cavalry came rushing in. The sound of horseshoes was like thunder, and the ground trembled from being kicked.

The soldiers of the Yu Kingdom are all elites, each one can be said to have crawled out of the dead. In order to train these soldiers, Zhong Yu selected millions of people from the Three Kingdoms world, and finally trained them. A mere 600,000.

And these 600,000 died to the current 150,000, and these people have all experienced the previous attack by the gods and survived. It can be said that they survived a hundred battles. The charge was intimidated.

Naturally, those veterans of the Royal Kingdom quickly formed an formation, but within a mere ten minutes, they were arranged in a tight formation. Spearmen, sword and shield soldiers, crossbowmen, and some other scattered soldiers formed together. A line of death that is enough to cause heavy losses to any incoming enemy and is difficult to cross.

However, these Yuguo veterans are naturally well-trained, experienced, and able to assemble quickly, but those Yan Guo surrendered soldiers who were coerced by Yuguo.

Morale was low at first, but because the family was controlled by Yu Guo, they had to obey orders as a last resort.

At this moment, seeing the soldiers of his own country rushing towards his army formation like divine soldiers from the sky, how could he be willing to risk his life to stop the soldiers of his country of Yan!

Therefore, the positions defended by the soldiers of the State of Yan retreated privately one after another. No matter how their imperial officials scolded them, and even killed many soldiers of the State of Yan, they still refused to step forward and become enemies.

"You are worthy of being a soldier of my country Yan. Even if you surrender, you have no choice. The two armies will not fight against my country Yan. It seems that people's hearts are in my country. God bless my Yan. I promise that I will not die!" Prince Edward Dan saw the soldiers on the opposite side of him retreat one after another. After looking carefully, he found that he was the original soldier of Yan Kingdom. He was overjoyed and sighed this sentence.

"Hurry up, take this opportunity quickly, rush out of this encirclement, don't pester those soldiers, they are all Yan people, you can't fight yourself, even if the camp is different at this moment!" As he rushed forward, he suddenly remembered something, Prince Dan of Yan turned to his side The soldier ordered.

"Yes, this subordinate takes orders!" The surrounding soldiers shouted loudly, and then charged the other soldiers with the prince's order.

With Prince Dan's sudden acceleration, many Yan cavalry followed Prince Dan, took him as the center of the arrow, broke out towards the gap, and left the battlefield in a short time.

Looking at these soldiers of Yan State, riding Juechen without any hindrance, they left the battlefield in two or three strokes and rushed out of the encirclement circle set by themselves.

An army of 300,000 surrounded Yandu, and the dense defense line seemed to be in vain, leaving no damage to the enemy, and it was like paper that could be torn apart.

Hearing the news, Zhong Yu, who had already stood on the commanding platform watching the situation on the battlefield, couldn't help being furious when he saw the performance of these troops from the Kingdom of Yan.

"These bastards, I know I can't believe it, and I still have to rely on the warriors of my imperial kingdom. Come, the cavalry team is ready, catch up with me, and wipe out these escaped soldiers of the Yan Kingdom!"

"Yes, my minister, Zhang Liao, will take orders immediately, so the commander of the hussar battalion will go forward and give chase, and we will not let the cavalry of the Yan Kingdom go wild in front of our Yuguo army!" He is a general of the cavalry, and he is naturally very keen on chasing the cavalry.

"Your Majesty, the minister is also willing to go!" Other generals, such as Ma Chao, Xu Huang, Zhao Yun, Zhang Fei and others, also spoke together, pleading for Zhong Yu's order.

"Since this is the case, all of you should go ahead. You must take Yandan for me, annihilate all his 30,000 cavalry, and then go out into the wild. He must not be allowed to cause any hindrance to our country's strategy!" Zhong Yu Yan Sheng said, the tone was full of murderous intent.

"Yes!" The five generals all bowed and promised to arrive, and then turned around to leave. The iron boots and battle armor on their bodies were rattling as they stepped on the road.

Zhong Yu saw that the five generals under his command had already led the army to go out, the cavalry team in the barracks was ready, and the first man got on his horse and left the barracks, looking for Yan Dan's trail.

He turned his head again, ready to deal with those disobedient people in his barracks.

"Gao Shun, you lead your 10,000 camps, go to the place where the surrendered soldiers were breached by Yan Dan, catch those presumptuous surrendered soldiers, and behead them every ten times to scare the surrendered soldiers. Let's see if they dare to neglect my military orders in the future!"

"Yes, the last general will take orders now, and we must clean up these disorderly soldiers who do not respect military orders." Gao Shun, with a serious face, replied in response. Teach those who surrendered, what is military discipline? What is military law?

"Well, you can go now, and you, also disperse separately, return to each battalion to rectify your soldiers, I am tired, I have to go back to the camp to rest!" Zhong Yu sent out his two orders, feeling a little tired, and dismissed The generals returned to their camp with a group of servants.

A group of ministers and generals bowed and respectfully sent their emperor away. After a long time, they didn't hear footsteps before they got up, looked at each other, sighed a few times, and went back to the camp.

"Yuanhao, what decision do you think His Majesty will make regarding this matter this time?" Xun Yu asked Tian Feng who was beside him as he walked on the road.

"I don't know, but with His Majesty's temperament, I'm afraid many people will die this time!" Tian Feng was asked, how could he dare to speak nonsense, he responded with a word, and left with a grunt.

"This Tian Feng, really..." Xun Yu watched Tian Feng playing sloppy with him, and cursed with a smile.

At this moment, in the distance, Gao Shun was where his army was, and there was a commotion, but it was calmed down in a moment.

What followed were screams and begging for mercy, and the land was about to be stained red with blood again.
